archived_baseline_fold_table.source_format: Five official outer-fold scores per evaluated task/method; source_value records the value in the source unit.
archived_baseline_fold_table.unit_conversion: coGN/coNGN energy columns mp_gap, mp_e_form and perovskites are divided by 1000 to match the manuscript eV units; remaining columns retain source units.

released_stage1_outer_fold_score.reason: The Table 2 footnote specifies the frozen JMP-L Stage 1 predictions from all five official folds for MP band gap.

scope: 130 final fold scores for 26 task/method combinations reported in the article.
aggregate: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across five official folds; rounding only at display.
